name: hdie_svc_stack_fault-hkb-sf-COMMIT
purpose: HBM d4g per-quadrant stack fault sfault_<q>/fs_<q> (x4, #(MUT0,OWN_W6,NPC16,NG4,ND8) per d4g_gen2 port_bind). HBM-KITS-B 10-18: RTL CDC body restored (merge e37520d6c had dropped ot_hbm_svc_fault_cdc/ot_reset_sync from the parameterised module: undeclared ca_s/pc_s/ow_s); kit at the d4g params, 21.6 x 21.6 slot; benches on Verilator 5.050. QF-SFAULT 10-18: ot_hbm_svc_fault_cdc per-domain ot_reset_sync (was: pending/sent/sticky cleared from both resets unsynchronised, 13 recovery paths -241 ps) + async_gray_fifo reset-synchroniser-input Gate-Rule.

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault #(.MUT(0), .OWN_W(6), .NPC(16), .NG(4), .ND(8)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: sf_exact
bench.pass_regex: ^PASS tb_hbm_svc_stack_fault MUT=0 OWN_W=6 NPC=16 NG=4 ND=8

bench.name: fault_cdc_unit
